prompts.core:
Create one production-ready bitmap pixel-art animation sprite sheet of Metal Gear Sahelanthropus from Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain, faithfully based on the original GRAY camouflage upright biped design, not the Black Version and not REX. Reference design: official Konami https://www.konami.com/mg/mgs5/tpp/jp/goods/item_pla_sahelanthropus.html and supervised Kotobukiya 1/100 https://www.kotobukiya.co.jp/en/product/detail/p4934054025107/. The supplied design description is critical: tall narrow articulated humanoid chassis, distinct narrow waist/pelvis, long mechanical arms with articulated hands, chunky angular thighs leading to unusually long slender shins and compact segmented feet. Downward-pointing elongated dinosaur skull-like armored head in front of upper torso with red sensor eyes and subtle white skull marking. A LARGE SPHERICAL RADOME behind the LEFT shoulder, not a flat radar dish. One extremely long dark angular railgun attached behind the RIGHT shoulder, rising diagonally above torso or pivoting forward to fire; visible shield on left forearm. Several small ivory cylinders near the chest and orange accents. Medium light warm gray armor with slate-gray patch camouflage, anthracite exposed joints, dark gun barrel. No humanoid face, no Gundam face or helmet, no heroic bright red/blue paint. 
LAYOUT: square image, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows = 16 full-body authored poses. Identical strict SIDE-VIEW camera facing RIGHT in all16 cells, tiny consistent three-quarter reveal only to distinguish arms and spherical radome. Each cell square, exactly equally sized, centered actor, consistent body height about70%cellheight allowing cannon headroom, constant feet baseline near85%cellheight. Saturated uniform flat magenta #FF00FF entire background with five straight thin cyan #00FFFF vertical lines and five horizontal lines at the exact quarter boundaries including outer border. 20px magenta safety margin inside each cell. Nothing touches any guide. No text, numbers, labels, ground, scenery, UI, shadows or gradient background. Readable professionally authored 2D game pixel-art clusters, dark crisp outlines and controlled highlights, detailed mechanical anatomy, not photorealistic, not 3D toy photography.
ROW1 IDLE: four subtly different articulated idle mechanical-breathing phases upright, arms low, weight shifting gently, red sensor subtly scanning forward. 
ROW2 MOVE: four distinct coherent heavy WALK cycle phases to right; one forward contact, compression, opposite passing leg, opposite contact. Torso/radome/weapon same design and scale, feet move naturally, not duplicated rotated sprites.
ROW3 CHARGE: four consecutive weapon preparation poses: feet brace, right shoulder railgun pivots forward, shoulder leans into aimed barrel, small concentrated orange-white charge at barrel tip. Keep hands present; railgun is SHOULDER-MOUNTED NOT a handheld assault rifle. All barrel and effects stay inside cell.
ROW4 ATTACK: four consecutive railgun firing phases: full aiming, brief compact white-orange muzzle pulse, mechanical recoil with bent knees, initial barrel return. Compact muzzle effect only, no long beam or projectile trail (projectiles handled by game). Same canonical body and armor all16poses. Each pose must be complete and independently drawn. Original fan-game adaptation of canonical design, not copied official artwork.

Make the large gray shield on its left forearm readable without changing its design. Original fan-game adaptation of MGSV TPP canonical Sahelanthropus, not REX, not Gundam.
Exactly4columns×4rows=16 complete poses, square image, equal squarecells, each same scale and camera as attached. Background solid magenta #FF00FF and5thin cyan guide lines each direction on quarterboundaries including border. At least20pxclearspace within eachcell, no limb/weapon/effect touchesguides, no labels/text/logo/scenery, crisp detailed pixelart not3Drender.
Row1 RECOVER: 4 phases immediately following the attached row4 railgun shot: braced knees and barrel forward; gun returns slowly higher; arms settle; exact upright neutral stance similar core row1. Keep feet baseline near85%cellheight.
Row2 HIT: four distinct restrained recoil reaction poses: shoulder jolts, torso bends back slightly, knees absorb impact, almostrestored. Tiny gray metal fragments/compact orange sparks allowed but body remains fully visible, not red recolor, not gore.
Row3 DEATH: four consecutive collapse poses grounded near same85%baseline: legs buckle; one knee touches ground; torso folds forward with radome and cannon remainingattached; collapsed ruined machine on ground, eyesdark, limbs/shield recognizable, completewreckwithin cell. No huge explosion obscuring anatomy.
Row4 SCAN: four slow stable upright phases near core row1 neutral scale: head inclinesforward, head raises, head returns, spherical radar rotates subtly and one hand makes small adjustment. No reversal/different camera, no horizontalflip, alwaysnosefacesright. No giant beams or projectiles. Eachphase must be truly authored, not translated, stretched orrotatedduplicates. Full consistency with attached core sheet is essential.
